note: runEditor (packages/director/src/editor-agent.ts) loads these skills through SkillLibrary into its optional model review and records their versions in the output's provenance. The deterministic checks do not depend on the model.

skills.name: core-contract
skills.purpose: The Editor decision flow and the line between Editor decisions and changes that need Director reapproval.
invoke_when: start of every Editor job
before returning any EditorOutput

skills.name: footage-review
skills.purpose: Verify approved footage against measured evidence; report missing, unusable or ambiguous media without claiming visual understanding.
invoke_when: an operation touches a video, image or audio asset

skills.name: continuity-pacing
skills.purpose: Check narrative and action continuity, variety and rhythm inside the approved scene timing.
invoke_when: after footage review
before assembling transitions

skills.name: transitions-scene-assembly
skills.purpose: Turn approved transitions and scene order into typed operations; cuts by default.
invoke_when: a scene has transition_out
the plan has a transition recipe

skills.name: captions-typography
skills.purpose: Place approved on-screen text exactly and legibly; report unsupported caption types.
invoke_when: a scene has an overlay
the plan uses a text animation recipe
the brief mentions captions

skills.name: audio-voiceover-mixing
skills.purpose: Place approved audio cues, ducking and loudness steps from measured evidence; report unsupported audio capabilities.
invoke_when: a scene has audio_cues or source audio
the plan uses a sound_cue recipe

skills.name: motion-graphics-product-ui
skills.purpose: Apply approved graphics and camera recipes with restraint; show product UI only as supplied assets.
invoke_when: the plan uses an animation, camera_move or shot recipe
a scene uses screenshots or screen recordings

skills.name: remotion-implementation
skills.purpose: Rules and verified facts for handing validated operations to reviewed Remotion templates later. Documentation only.
invoke_when: an operation has a remotion/ implementation_ref
designing the renderer boundary

skills.name: final-video-qa
skills.purpose: Separate pre-render plan checks (implemented) from post-render media checks (not implemented).
invoke_when: before returning an EditorOutput
after every render, once a renderer exists

skills.name: safe-assets-and-tools
skills.purpose: Untrusted-input, path, integrity and no-execution rules for every Editor job.
invoke_when: every Editor job
a path, URL, command, package or external skill appears
